publisher: Alaska Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development, Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
ownership: Official public Alaska business-license records made available as full CSV downloads by DCCED
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS full CSV downloads. DCCED presents the files as a service to the public, warns that manipulation may be required, does not verify submitted information, and disclaims accuracy and reliability warranties.
allowed_use: official full HTTPS business-license and NAICS downloads
immutable internal privacy-minimized selected-field source retention
conditional provisional physical-site normalization from complete reported U.S. street addresses
derived local business-registry assertions and source-linked relationships
prohibited_use: representing source Active status as independent proof of continuous operations, public access, good standing, solvency, or compliance with every occupational or local requirement
representing the one reported physical address as a complete location inventory or independently verified operating site
representing this licensing source as every Alaska or United States business
persisting or publishing Owners or mailing-address fields
persisting raw PhysicalLine2 values that may contain phone or other contact data
publishing record-level natural-person names or possible residential addresses without an approved privacy and terms review
redistributing aggregate outputs without a separate terms review
inferring ownership, parent company, network affiliation, or cross-source identity without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Alaska Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development, Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing, Business License and NAICS downloads.
retention: Indefinite for immutable privacy-minimized selected-field source and governed normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Record-level artifacts remain local-review-only. Aggregate redistribution requires a separate review of the Alaska site terms and must retain attribution, observation window, checksums, provenance, and license/address limitations.
personal_data_handling: Business names can identify sole proprietors and reported physical addresses can be residences. Owners and all mailing fields are excluded before persistence. Raw PhysicalLine2 is excluded because it contains contact-like and unstructured values; only conservative unit designators may be retained.
